content.comment_body: What is the latest version of [product_name]? Thanks.
The most recent version is [product_name] with [version_no] [article_no]. Both the base module and the operator device have updated order numbers. See the attached document.
Thanks. I noticed in the accessories section that programming software is listed. Do I need to buy the software separately, or does it come included with the purchase of [product_name]?
If you own a previous full version of [product_name] programming software, you can upgrade to the new version for free. If you do not have a previous full version, you'll need to purchase it.

Thanks. When ordering [product_name], do I need to order the software as well? I assumed the software would be included with the hardware for programming. Does the hardware come with programming software?
No, the software is not included with a purchase of [product_name]. You must buy it separately.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are requesting clarification on the newest hardware versions of [product_name] and whether the programming software is included with the hardware or requires a separate purchase. There is confusion stemming from unclear product packaging and sales details regarding software availability, especially for new users.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect the programming software for [product_name] to be included with a hardware purchase or easily obtainable. They look for transparent product version information and clarity on what is provided in the package.
